entries.title: Homepage repositioned around Casual Mode with three primary provider cards (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).

Developer surface consolidated at `/developer` with API, MCP, datasets, embed, and reliability links.
Embed widget launched at `/embed` with JS/SVG/JSON variants.
Active incident normalization guard shipped to prevent `status: unknown` on active incidents.
Six-way cross-project mesh references aligned across machine-readable surfaces.
OpenAPI parity restored between apex and well-known paths.
Incident detail endpoint lookup regression fixed.
Discovery audit and RSS freshness pipeline restored.
Footer rendering unified; legal markdown mirrors shipped.
Automated public issue triage workflow removed.

Visibility and discoverability audits returned green in CI.
Baseline discovery artifacts and public datasets published.
